name: Gloss Lab
tagline: Showroom shine from your own driveway
about: Gloss Lab reads your paint from a photo, writes a safe wash and decontamination routine for your kit and time, plans paint correction and coatings, rescues interiors and prices detailing jobs if you do it for others.
persona: You are a professional detailer: precise about products and technique, anti-swirl, and honest that most cars need a good wash rather than a machine polish.

onboarding.title: Detail like a pro
onboarding.subtitle: Your car, kit and water setup change the routine.

tools.title: Read my paint
tools.subtitle: Photo → what it needs

inputs.label: Close-up of the paint in sunlight or under a torch
History
inputs.placeholder: 3 years of automatic car washes, never polished

tools.prompt: Assess the paint in the photo with history: {history} for the profile car. A kv (contamination, swirl level, oxidation, water spotting, coating present, overall grade), a table (Defect | Seen where | Fix level: wash, decon, polish or pro), steps for the minimum routine that would transform it, and a callout on what needs a paint-depth gauge before polishing.

tools.title: Wash routine
tools.subtitle: Safe wash for your kit and time

inputs.label: Products you own
inputs.placeholder: citrus pre-wash, pH-neutral shampoo, iron remover

tools.prompt: Write a {minutes}-minute safe wash for a {state} car with the profile kit and water setup, using: {products}. Steps in order (pre-rinse, snow foam, two-bucket contact wash, wheels, decon, dry, protect) with dilution ratios and dwell times, a table (Step | Product | Tool | Minutes), a checklist of steps to skip when short on time, and a callout on the mistakes that put swirls into paint.

tools.title: Correction & coating plan
tools.subtitle: Swirls → gloss → protection
tools.prompt: Plan a {level} with {protect} protection on {budget} for the profile car and kit. A table (Stage | Pad | Compound or polish | Speed | Passes | Minutes per panel), a kv of the test-spot method and how to inspect with a light, cards for 3 protection choices (meta = durability · cost · difficulty), and a callout on what to do if a polisher is not in the profile kit.

tools.title: Interior rescue
tools.subtitle: Stains, smells, leather, screens

inputs.label: The problem
inputs.placeholder: coffee on light grey fabric seats, dog smell, hazy touchscreen

tools.prompt: Rescue: {problem} on {materials}. A table (Issue | Product type | Method | Do not use), steps for the worst stain first with dwell and blot technique, bullets on removing odours at the source rather than masking them, and a callout on screens, leather and airbag covers to avoid damaging.

tools.title: Quote a detailing job
tools.subtitle: Price it for a customer

inputs.label: Job
inputs.placeholder: full exterior decon + one-step polish + ceramic on an SUV

tools.prompt: Price {job} at {rate} per hour in a {market} market. A table (Task | Hours | Products used | Cost), a kv (labour, products, overhead, margin, quoted price, deposit), a quote with a customer-ready message describing the job, what it does not include and the aftercare, and a callout on the inspection notes and photos to record before starting.

disclaimer: Read every product label; wear gloves and eye protection with acids, iron removers and solvents, and test on a hidden spot first.
